description: This file contains source code for the torch._functorch.apis module, defining various functional APIs such as vmap, grad, and grad_and_value, which are used for advanced tensor operations, automatic differentiation, and vectorized programming within the PyTorch framework.

methods.name: Callable vmap( func: Callable, in_dims: in_dims_t = 0, out_dims: out_dims_t = 0, randomness: str = "error", *, chunk_size=None, )
methods.description: Creates a vectorized map function that applies a given function over batches of inputs with configurable batch dimensions and randomness behavior.

methods.name: Callable chunk_vmap( func: Callable, in_dims: in_dims_t = 0, out_dims: out_dims_t = 0, randomness: str = "error", chunks=2, )
methods.description: Creates a batched map that processes inputs in chunks, combining features of vmap and sequential mapping for memory efficiency.

methods.name: Callable grad(func: Callable, argnums: argnums_t = 0, has_aux: bool = False)
methods.description: Computes the gradient of a function with respect to specified input arguments, supporting nesting and higher-order derivatives.

methods.name: Callable grad_and_value( func: Callable, argnums: argnums_t = 0, has_aux: bool = False )
methods.description: Returns a function that computes both the gradient and the primal value (forward pass) of a given function, useful for advanced automatic differentiation workflows.
